net.guizhanss.fastmachines.utils.items.builder

Class SlimefunItemBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.guizhanss.fastmachines.utils.items.builder.SlimefunItemBuilder

  • public class SlimefunItemBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
    A small builder for constructing a SlimefunItem, adapted for FastMachines. Replaces the upstream Kotlin property-delegate DSL: the item is constructed directly through a typed SlimefunItemBuilder.ItemFactory rather than reflectively, so no kotlin-reflect is involved.
